name: ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}
initializeCommand:
alias.devcontainer-env=!f() { set -eu; prefix=$(basename "$PWD" | LC_ALL=C tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' | LC_ALL=C tr -c 'A-Z0-9_
' '_'); umask 077; temp_file=$(mktemp .devcontainer/.env.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -f "$temp_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM; write_env() { value=$(printenv "${prefix}_$2" || true); if [ "$value" != "$(printf '%s' "$value" | tr -d '
')" ]; then printf 'Environment variable %s_%s must be a single line.
' "$prefix" "$2" >&2; exit 1; fi; printf '%s=%s
' "$1" "$value" >> "$temp_file"; }; write_env GIT_AUTHOR_NAME DEV_GIT_NAME; write_env GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL DEV_GIT_EMAIL; write_env GIT_COMMITTER_NAME DEV_GIT_NAME; write_env GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL DEV_GIT_EMAIL; write_env GH_TOKEN GH_TOKEN; mv -f "$temp_file" .devcontainer/.env; }; f
postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.codex /home/vscode/.agents /home/vscode/.treehouse && git config --global --add safe.directory ${containerWorkspaceFolder} && DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx --yes skills@1.7.0 add mattpocock/skills --global --agent codex --yes
